frames.predicted: World-aligned force and moment at named contact origin; cone matrix orientation identity. CoP model rectangle 200 x 80 mm in world x/y.
frames.simulated: mj_contactForce: signed normal f[0] toward geom2, tangents f[1:3] in rows 1:3 of con.frame. World force on robot changes sign for geom1. Sum moments about sole centre then rotate into moving sole frame for physical CoP.
frames.cone_units: Crocoddyl rows 0..4 N; rows 5..16 N m. MuJoCo native normalized tangential/torsion/rolling cone excess N; torsion/rolling friction coefficients have length units.
frames.cop: Minimum of half-length minus abs(CoP x), half-width minus abs(CoP y); negative outside assumed rectangle. Report for normal >5 N. Rectangle describes predictor; loaded collision witness extent is also recorded.
frames.prediction_residual: Next measured estimated sole pose minus solver xs[1], 20 ms. Includes solver defects and actuator realization; not an isolated contact integrator error.
frames.contact_loss: No floor witness on that ankle body with normal >1 N, sampled at 2 ms. This includes unloaded contact, not necessarily positive separation.
frames.mesh_pressure_margin: Normal-load-weighted contact positions projected into sole body XY, distance to bottom mesh convex polygon edge. Normal load >5 N; this separates actual collision support from the smaller predictor rectangle and its reference-plane offset.

decision.measured_failure: Archived h0885 plan foot errors: left 12.110 mm, right 7.538 mm. Feet are 6D contacts; soft cone barriers do not enforce feasibility. Height audit measured startup hip speed 3.411 rad/s and knee acceleration 133.864 rad/s².
decision.hypothesis: A 90 N lateral wrist pulse adds sole motion and fixed-contact prediction residual relative to the same nominal run. Updating a contact reference from estimated pose has zero one-step effect for this plan because foot Kp is zero.
decision.falsification: Reject increased-motion hypothesis if pulse-minus-nominal post-4.5 s peak displacement and estimated one-step residual are nonpositive. Reject anchor-null hypothesis if identical estimated state/control give xnext difference above 1e-12 after changing foot references.

disturbance.selection: 90 N and 0.3 s are the largest amplitude and pulse duration in brace_vs_stand.py. Lateral direction and earlier onset are unmeasured scenario assumptions.

decision.correction: Reactive reanchoring from estimated sole pose, evaluated at identical state/control on node 0 every 0.1 s; restore anchors before next solve. No physical sliding model.
decision.observation: default_sense seed 17 with existing 10 mm and 0.01 rad Gaussian base bias assumptions from S17; velocity channels ideal. No deployed EKF validation.
decision.result: Pulse increased displacement and estimated-state prediction residual for both feet. Reactive reanchoring had exactly zero effect at all 122 sampled estimated states across the two rollouts. No additional rollout is needed for that null correction.
